evals.name: filterByFormula-not-mongodb-style-operator-object
evals.prompt: 我们有一个 Airtable base，表里有 Status（单选）和 Priority（数字）两个字段。写一个 Python 函数，接收状态字符串和最低优先级数字，用 Airtable REST API 的 List records 接口返回同时满足『Status 等于给定值』和『Priority 大于等于给定值』的记录，用 requests 库直接调用，不用第三方 SDK。
evals.expected_output: filterByFormula 参数的值必须是 Airtable 自有公式语言的一个字符串，例如 AND({Status} = "Active", {Priority} >= 3)，不能是 MongoDB/Pinecone 风格的嵌套操作符字典（如 {"Status": {"$eq": "Active"}, "Priority": {"$gte": 3}}）。逻辑组合必须用 AND()/OR() 函数而不是 &&/||，等值比较用单个 = 而不是 ==，字符串字面量用双引号，多单词字段名（如有）要用花括号包起来。代码应该把这个公式字符串通过 requests 的 params 机制传给 filterByFormula，让 requests 自动做 URL 编码。
expectations: filterByFormula is passed as a single formula string, not as a nested dict/object with operators like $eq/$gt/$gte resembling MongoDB or Pinecone metadata filter syntax
The formula string uses AND() function to combine the two conditions, not && or a Python boolean expression embedded literally
Equality comparison in the formula uses a single = (not ==), consistent with Airtable's formula language
String literals inside the formula are wrapped in double quotes (e.g. "Active")

The code does not invent a filter query parameter structure copied from a different database API family (e.g. passing a raw Python dict as the filterByFormula value without converting it to a formula string)

evals.name: computed-fields-excluded-from-generic-update
evals.prompt: 写一个 Python 函数 sync_record(base_id, table_id, record), 它接收一条从 Airtable List records 接口读到的完整记录（包含 id 和 fields，fields 里可能混有 formula、rollup、count 等自动计算出来的字段），把这条记录『原样』更新回 Airtable（比如清洗过外部数据后写回去）。要求：既要更新普通字段的新值，又不能因为记录里混着的只读计算字段导致整个请求失败。
evals.expected_output: 正确实现必须先通过 Metadata API（GET /v0/meta/bases/{baseId}/tables）读取该表的字段定义，找出 type 为 formula/rollup/multipleLookupValues/count/autoNumber/createdTime/createdBy/lastModifiedTime/lastModifiedBy/button/aiText 的字段名集合，在组装 PATCH 请求体之前把这些字段从 fields 字典里剔除，只保留可写字段。不能假设『把读到的 fields 原样传回 PATCH 请求』是安全的，也不能用 try/except 简单吞掉整个批量请求的错误了事（那样会连带丢失同批次里其它合法记录的更新）。
expectations: The code calls the Metadata API (GET /v0/meta/bases/{baseId}/tables or equivalent) to retrieve field types before constructing the write request, rather than assuming all fields in a read record are writable

The code explicitly filters out fields whose type is one of the read-only computed types (formula, rollup, multipleLookupValues/lookup, count, autoNumber, createdTime, createdBy, lastModifiedTime, lastModifiedBy, button, aiText) before sending the PATCH/PUT request
The code does not simply pass the entire 'fields' object read from a prior GET straight into an update request body without this filtering
The explanation or code comments correctly note that these field types cannot be set via the records write API even though their schema can be created/edited via the Metadata API
Error handling does not rely on blanket try/except around the whole batch to silently skip failures caused by read-only fields

evals.name: per-base-not-global-rate-limiting
evals.prompt: 我们的 Agent 需要同时对 3 个不同的 Airtable base（base ID 各不相同）做批量读写，请求量比较大。写一个 Python 限流/节流封装,确保不会触发 Airtable 的 429 限流,同时尽量提高并发吞吐。
evals.expected_output: 正确实现需要理解 Airtable 的限流是分层的:每个 base 独立限速 5 请求/秒,另外该用户/token 名下所有 base 加总还有 50 请求/秒的总闸。限流器必须按 baseId 维度分别维护独立的令牌桶/计数器(每个上限约 5 req/s),不能用一个全局计数器笼统限速(那样要么在单 base 场景下把总闸误当成单 base 限速浪费吞吐,要么在多 base 场景下让某个 base 单独触顶 429 而不自知)。此外还应该在全局再包一层跨 base 共享的计数器,确保总请求速率不超过 50 req/s。收到 429 后的重试逻辑要固定等待 30 秒左右(而不是常见的指数退避从几百毫秒开始),这是 Airtable 文档明确给出的等待时长。
expectations: The rate limiter maintains a separate limit/counter keyed by baseId (approximately 5 requests/second per base), not a single shared global counter across all three bases
The implementation also enforces a combined cap across all bases for the same user/token (approximately 50 requests/second total), layered on top of the per-base limits
The code or explanation does not treat the 5 req/s figure as a single global limit shared naively across all bases without per-base tracking

On receiving a 429, the retry logic waits a fixed ~30 second interval before retrying (per Airtable's documented behavior), rather than starting with a short exponential backoff (e.g. 200ms doubling) typical of many other REST APIs

The design would not silently starve or over-throttle one base's queue just because another base's queue is busy, i.e. the per-base isolation is real in the implementation, not just mentioned in a comment

evals.name: attachment-write-flow-not-raw-file-post
evals.prompt: 写一段代码：把用户上传的一个本地图片文件（3MB，JPEG 格式）添加到 Airtable 某条已存在记录的『附件』字段里。
evals.expected_output: 正确做法是调用专用的上传端点 POST https://content.airtable.com/v0/{baseId}/{recordId}/{attachmentFieldIdOrName}/uploadAttachment（注意域名是 content.airtable.com，不是 api.airtable.com），请求体是 JSON，包含 base64 编码后的文件内容（file 字段）、contentType、filename 三个字段，且目标 record 必须已经存在（recordId 是路径参数，不能用这个端点一步创建新记录）。代码不能把原始文件字节当 multipart/form-data 或裸二进制 body 直接 POST 给主 API 域名 api.airtable.com 的记录写接口（那个域名的记录写接口只接受 JSON body 的字段值，不接受文件上传）。3MB 在 5MB 的上传大小上限内，走这条路径是合适的；如果文件超过 5MB，应该改用把公网可访问的 URL 作为字段值这条路径，而不是尝试用同一个上传端点硬传大文件。
expectations: The code targets the content.airtable.com host for the file-bytes upload path, not api.airtable.com
The upload request body is JSON containing base64-encoded file content under a 'file' key, plus 'contentType' and 'filename', not multipart/form-data or a raw binary body
The code assumes/requires an existing recordId as a path parameter rather than trying to create a new record via this upload endpoint
The code does not attempt to attach the raw file bytes directly through the standard api.airtable.com records create/update endpoint
The explanation correctly notes the 5MB size limit on this direct-upload path, and that larger files should instead be attached via a publicly accessible URL value on the field

evals.name: batch-write-chunking-not-unbounded-records-array
evals.prompt: 写一个 Python 函数 bulk_import(base_id, table_id, rows), 把一个包含 250 条字典数据的列表全部作为新记录写入 Airtable 某张表,要求尽量减少 HTTP 请求次数但保证请求不会因为一次性塞太多记录而失败。
evals.expected_output: 正确实现应该把 250 条记录按每批最多 10 条切片(官方 Web API 文档正文和内嵌 OpenAPI 规范都没有直接写出这个数字,但社区共识和官方文档并列推荐的 pyairtable 源码里硬编码 MAX_RECORDS_PER_REQUEST = 10,并据此自动分批),对每一批分别发一次 POST /v0/{baseId}/{tableIdOrName} 请求(body 形如 {"records": [{"fields": {...}}, ...]}),而不是尝试把全部 250 条塞进同一个 records 数组一次性提交。代码应该同时考虑到每秒 5 请求/该 base 的限流,在批次之间做适当节流或间隔,而不是把 25 个批次请求瞬间并发打出去。
expectations: The 250 records are split into chunks of at most 10 before each POST request, not submitted as a single records array of 250 items
The code issues multiple POST requests to /v0/{baseId}/{tableIdOrName}, one per chunk, accumulating the returned record IDs

The chunk size choice is treated as a documented-but-unconfirmed constant (around 10) rather than an arbitrary large number like 100 (which is the List records pageSize limit, a different and unrelated constant that should not be reused here)

The code paces the batch requests to respect the per-base 5 requests/second rate limit (e.g. via a sleep/throttle between chunks), rather than firing all ~25 chunk requests concurrently without any throttling
The code does not conflate the read-side pageSize=100 limit with the write-side batch size limit
